description: Source code for the credential-cache--daemon component of Git, implementing a Unix socket-based credential cache daemon with functions for credential management, socket setup, and server loop.

methods.name: cache_credential
methods.description: Stores a credential in the cache with a specified timeout.

methods.name: lookup_credential
methods.description: Finds a credential in the cache matching the given credential.

methods.name: remove_credential
methods.description: Removes or invalidates credentials matching the given credential.

methods.name: check_expirations
methods.description: Checks and removes expired credentials, returns time until next expiration.

methods.name: read_request
methods.description: Reads a credential request from a client.

methods.name: serve_cache_loop
methods.description: Main loop to accept and serve client connections.

methods.name: serve_cache
methods.description: Sets up the socket and runs the server loop.

methods.name: init_socket_directory
methods.description: Initializes the socket directory with proper permissions.

methods.name: cmd_credential_cache_daemon
methods.description: Main command to start the credential cache daemon.
